items.summary:
What's Changed

Support for Cohere2Moe architecture
Fixed LFM2 parser/render for cases where thinking was not emitted
Fixed issue where ollama launch claude and other coding agent or assistant use cases would only output one token
Ollama will now return an error if a single message is larger than the current context window

items.title: Microsoft might put China’s DeepSeek inside Copilot to tame its AI bills
items.summary:
Microsoft is considering putting a Chinese AI model inside its enterprise Copilot, and the reason is money. The company told Axios it is exploring a self-hosted, fine-tuned version of DeepSeek V4, or another open-source model, as a cheaper option to power Copilot Cowork, the agentic assistant in its Microsoft 365 suite. items.title: The Gemini-Powered Google Home Speaker Is Finally Here

items.title: Estonia wants to give every AI agent its own ID number
items.summary:

items.summary: Pinterest has launched 'Ask Pinterest,' an experimental AI-powered shopping app that lets users seek recommendations and inspiration through a conversational interface.
